scope: Frontend font discovery and bounded external-metrics inspector; no new menu artwork or runtime replacement enabled.
findings: Software routines prepare bitmap font pages; the accelerated frontend text path draws glyph sprites from them.
Large, regular and reduced text sizes have different original sampling offsets and geometry.
Straight overwrite reconstruction differs at68pixels; every difference lies where source glyphs overlap. This is not a byte-exact reconstruction of the original compositing.
